key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Gradual with exertion, predictable pattern. LOCATION: RETROSTERNAL or left chest. RADIATES to left arm, jaw, shoulder. DURATION: Brief, typically 2-10 minutes. CHARACTER: Pressure, tightness, heaviness. AGGRAVATING: EXERTION, cold weather, heavy meals, emotional stress. RELIEVING: REST (within minutes) or nitroglycerin. TIMING: Reproducible with similar exertion levels. SEVERITY: 4-6/10, consistent. KEY POSITIVES: Predictable with exertion, relieved by rest in <5 minutes, relieved by nitroglycerin, history of CAD or risk factors. KEY NEGATIVES: NOT at rest (unstable angina), NOT unpredictable.
